description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipe for Qwen's official Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8 (block-wise FP8, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision da6e2ed2, about 80 GB of weights) served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: FlashInfer attention, FP8 KV cache, InstantTensor loading, prefix caching, qwen3_coder tool parsing, 131,072-token context and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); upstream sets no mods, batched-token limit or sequence capacity, so those stay at vLLM's defaults. Upstream's recipe is written for two Sparks; eugr's --solo mode runs the same command at tensor parallel 1 (the only override), which is this single-Spark recipe; the weights fit one Spark. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3-Coder-Next FP8 vLLM single Spark (eugr)
